image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a dual-headed traffic light assembly mounted on a metal pole. The left head shows an illuminated red light at the top, with two unlit lenses below (appearing blueish/dark). The right head shows an illuminated amber/yellow light at the top and a red light in the middle, with one unlit lens below. The background features a street scene with parked cars (a blue van and a silver sedan) and a building facade. The image has a grainy, vintage aesthetic.
